name: 14141 · Springville, NY
findings: ZIP 14141 (Springville) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14141 (Springville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14141 (Springville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
